description: Works out the seven FRS 105 balance sheet lines a micro-entity's accounts take, from the open DIYA-GL book: this year from the book's balance sheet and last year from its opening balance, in whole pounds with capital and reserves equal to net assets, plus the period dates, the company number and name, the first director and the employee count. Use this when the person asks what their micro-entity accounts will show, for their company's year-end balance sheet, or to check the figures before they file. It refuses a book whose balance sheets do not balance, and it does not file the accounts or contact Companies House.
name: derive_micro_entity_accounts
title: Derive micro-entity accounts
